monsters.seen: harpy_front/left (re-checked on a contact sheet): eagle-headed bird beast that reads more bird-man than bird-woman. Hooked beak with jagged teeth, glowing yellow eyes, spiky orange feather crest, feathered ruff on the chest. It has NO separate arms or hands: two big brown/red feathered wings come straight off the shoulders where the arms would be. They are spread level in the front view and raised in the side view. Gold-trimmed leather chest straps and a short armored skirt with small horn spikes at the hips. Short red tail feathers behind. Lean, light build. Thin yellow bird legs with gold/leather greaves and big curled talon feet, and the side view shows bent knees. Because the Mixamo arm bones will sit inside the wings, every arm cue is a wide, wing-like spread, and the attack uses the talons.
monsters.personality: Weak forest raider. A twitchy, shrill bird of prey: quick head twitches, always scanning, hit-and-run talon strikes. It is light and fast, so it moves in sharp bursts and recoils a lot. Attack concept: double-talon grasp (knees tucked, then both feet shoot forward together with talons spread). Hurt: knocked sideways like a bird thrown off balance, then levels out. Death concept: dead-bird drop (falls feet first, tips onto its back, legs curled up). [review] Idle: 'rising and lowering' became 'arms slowly beating up and down', so the AI does not add squats (Blender adds the bob). Attack: the word 'raking' was replaced by 'grasping' to keep clear of the skeleton X rake. Hurt: changed from a backward recoil to a sideways knock, because the wraith also recoils backward with its arms up. Death: reordered so 'lies still' comes last.

death.prompt: A winged harpy is struck in mid-air: head snaps back and arms flail upward, then it drops straight down feet first, knees buckle as it lands, it tips over backward onto its back, curls both legs up toward its chest, lets its arms fall flat and lies still.

monsters.seen: imp_front/left (re-checked): small, stocky red devil with an oversized bald head. Two curved horns, big pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes, a scowl with two small fangs. Medium bat wings come out of the upper back behind the shoulders, separate from the arms. Compact, muscular chibi body with a six-pack. A leather strap runs across the chest, plus a studded belt with a ragged leather loincloth. Long arms hang at its sides and end in clawed hands. Short thick legs with clawed feet. Correction: the side view shows a LONG thin tail with an arrowhead tip trailing behind (not a short one), but tails get no AI motion. The real arms and hands are free for gestures and throwing. It carries no prop, so the fireball is a VFX added later and the prompt only describes the throwing motion.
monsters.personality: Weak desert pest. A cocky, mischievous, smug brat: fidgets, swings its legs, folds its arms, and flies in a jaunty, showy way. Quick, comic timing. Attack concept: one-arm overhand fireball pitch (wind-up, whip, follow-through, cocky shrug). Hurt: knocked backward with its arms windmilling, then shakes an angry fist. Death concept: doubles over, drops, takes a clumsy forward roll and ends splayed on its back like a starfish. [review] Idle: removed 'like a kid on a tall stool', which risked a sitting pose and a sit-down transition that would break the loop. Also removed 'smug look', since there is no face rig. Run: 'legs kicking' became 'legs trailing behind ... in a quick tight flutter' to avoid running steps. Attack: a pitch normally includes a forward stride, so the prompt adds 'legs dangling' and 'without stepping', and it says 'as if pitching a fireball'. Hurt: the two-hands-on-head clutch was replaced because the lich hurt also puts a hand on the head (its crown).

monsters.personality: Mid-tier desert sentinel. A slow, ponderous, stubborn guardian statue come alive: heavy weight, small recoil, deliberate moves, rolls its shoulders. Attack concept: two-handed crushing clap (arms swing wide, then clap together in front of the chest). The other clips were already compliant. The death ends with 'completely still'.

monsters.seen: Front, left and right refs checked (front/left re-checked on a contact sheet). A pale icy-blue hooded ghost in one long tattered robe: a pointed hood with a black empty face and two glowing cyan slit eyes, a jagged icicle-edged capelet and collar, and wide bell sleeves. Long skeletal ice claws with hooked talons hang out of the sleeves, and the arms are held forward and out in an A-pose with the claws open. No legs or feet show: the robe ends in long dripping icicle tatters, and the side view is a slim, upright column with the claw reaching forward. Light, narrow build, about human height. No weapon or prop. The hood moves with the Head bone and the robe tatters follow the hidden legs, so the legs are kept together and hanging.
monsters.personality: A silent, weak, eerie stalker. It drifts and sways like a sheet in cold wind, reaches out with its claws, then swoops in suddenly like a reaper, and flinches like something startled when hit. It is light and fast with no weight behind it. Attack concept: one-arm diagonal reaping slash from high right to low left. Death concept: falling sheet. The wind leaves it, it goes limp and sways side to side as it sinks, then settles on its side, hunched in on itself. [review] Death: the old self-hug curl (curled up on the ground) overlapped 'howl and curl', and its arms-around-the-chest ending would match the lich's folded-hands death, so it became the limp, swaying falling-sheet sink. Run: 'almost level' became 'far forward', so the model does not lie prone on the floor, and the duration went from 1 s to 2 s for a cleaner loop (play it faster in-engine if needed). Hurt: 1 s became 2 s, because a stretch-up plus a return to the hover in 1 s would likely be cut off. Idle: added 'arms drifting gently' in case finger bones are not animated. Attack: added 'legs hanging together', and the wind-up is now 'high behind its head'.

hurt.prompt: A hooded ice wraith floating in place is struck: it jolts backward, stretching tall with both arms flung straight up and its hooded head tipped back, legs swinging forward, then sinks back and hunches forward into its hover pose, claws reaching ahead again.

monsters.seen: Front and left refs checked (re-checked on a contact sheet). A stylised skeleton king with a cream bone skull and a big grinning fanged jaw, glowing green eye sockets, and a tall dark iron spiked crown with rivets. It wears a rust-brown tattered robe with a heavy hood or cowl bunched around the shoulders, wide ragged sleeves, a riveted iron belt and a torn knee-length skirt. Long bony arms end in oversized skeletal hands with long, clawed fingers. Thin bare bone legs and large bony feet show below the robe. In the side view the skull juts forward of the chest with a slight stoop. Lean, about human height. No staff, weapon or prop. The crown moves with the Head bone.
monsters.personality: A proud and contemptuous undead sorcerer-king, the strong frost caster. It holds itself upright and regal, always weaving magic with its hands, and gives judgement with a single pointing finger instead of brute force. When hit, its first thought is its crown. It moves slowly and deliberately, with some weight, but is never clumsy. Attack concept: judgement point. Hand drawn up beside the skull, then the arm flung straight out to point one finger at the foe (the frost spell VFX comes from the fingertip). Death concept: lying in state. Too proud to fall, it sinks down, lays itself out on its back and folds its hands on its chest like a tomb effigy. [review] Death: the old backward topple with arms flung wide repeated 'falls back' and 'arch and sprawl', so it became the lying-in-state concept. Attack: the overhead raise copied the wraith's wind-up, so the hand now draws up beside the skull before the point. Idle: 'fingers writhing' became 'hands slowly circling', because finger bones may not be animated. Walk: added a slight forward lean (walk rule), and 'rising and sinking' now applies only to the hands, so the body makes no knee bobs (Blender adds the bob). Hurt: 'glares' became 'raises its chin', since there is no face rig.
